decisions.statement: Each file opens with a header saying the file was generated.
A function takes a void `this` before every other parameter.
One return is written as the return type and several returns as a tuple.
A call with variable returns ends its tuple in a rest of the last type.
An enum is a number type and an enum value a declared number.
An object with no methods and no parent is an empty type rather than an interface.
